1.7.0.description:
Changelog:

- Created custom loading tip messages - `ODRTip`
- Death messages now show up as loading screen Tooltips
- Fixed a bug that caused the credits screen to crash the game
- Fixed an issue with reachable map not displaying accurate information
- Fixed a bug where Flash Shift Upgrades granted 3 flashes instead of 1
- Fixed a issue where the logic engine assumed missile requirements were free even when starting missiles = 0
- Bypassed an issue where the Microsoft Store version of python failed to install completely
1.7.0.title: Version 1.7.0

- Added support for Metroid Dread 2.1.0

1.8.0.title: Version 1.8.0

1.8.2.description:
Changelog: 

- Created a YAML probe to detect unstable YAML configurations in the in-client YAML editor
- Greatly adjusted the Door Rando placement algorithym
- Fixed a bug where warping out of Elun caused Elun to be softlocked and unreachable
- In-client map tracker now only shows item icons relevant to the current configuration
- Fixed a bug that didnt grant Energy Tanks until player reload (took me long enough)
- Fixed a bug where stale EXEC caused the client to incorrectly detect a mismatched Seed ID
- Disabled automatic Start Kit sphere 0 placements (to better be in tandem with in-client YAML editor)
- Small `ap_to_patcher` optimizations
- Fixed a bug in the map reachability pusher that caused an overload during lag spike areas (like boss room transitions)
- Fixed a bug on Windows devices where the wizard-installed python enviroment wasnt even used by the client hub
- The client log panel is now visable on all stages of the client app
- Added more debug logs so now your logs folder is gonna be way too big
1.8.2.title: Version 1.8.2

1.8.3.description:
Changelog:

- Fixed a bug that caused Metroid DNA count to fail and halt the item collection queue
- (Hopefully) Fixed a bug that forced windows to use system dependancies instead of local dependancies
- Fixed a bug that left out Network and Map stations from the warpable save pool
- Added a couple generic loading screen tooltips. Will add substantially more soon.
1.8.3.title: Version 1.8.3
